plotEn:
MIT student Russell leaves academia to pursue research to address the decline of bee populations. He struggles to secure funding for his project until wealthy miniature poodle breeder Patti Kolb offers him support. After researching Patti with his fiancée Haley, Russell travels to her remote property to discuss the arrangement.
Over dinner, Patti introduces Russell to five women she calls her daughters: Ainsley, Cosette, Celeste, Manon, and Yara. Patti then reveals that she intends to extend her dog-breeding practices to humans, believing that selective reproduction can produce genetically superior offspring, and wants Russell to mate with Ainsley in exchange for a blank check to finance his project. Disturbed, Russell retreats to his car. Ainsley follows him and proposes that she fake a pregnancy in exchange for splitting the money so she can finally afford to leave the property; after some deliberation, Russell tentatively agrees. That night, he briefly goes outside past his designated curfew to answer a call from Haley; Patti confiscates his phone in retaliation.
The following night, Russell and Ainsley feign having sex, after which Ainsley reveals that she and the other girls have been forced to give birth to many children, which Patti subsequently sells on the black market. While searching for his phone in Patti's room, Russell finds files containing his personal information, as well as files on other men.
